triage.notes: The data pipeline infrastructure was started (import, parsing, preaggregation) but has a known looping bug and is disabled; no UI (routes, views, templates) was ever built. Fixing requires: (1) resolving the infinite-reprocessing bug in process_logs, (2) wiring played_cards_by_person to a decksite route/view, (3) building templates for card stats, match pages, etc. Performance was also a concern (4+ minute queries noted in issue comments).
